source_scope.source_detail_limit: Only the profile snapshot and login stream have detailed DDL. The other 28 assets are overview names without keys, columns, types, status dictionaries, retention, tenant grain, or source-system schemas and therefore remain provisional.

verification_policy.specified_definition: A user source has same-name DDL evidence plus explicit Principal/Profile/Authentication/Verification/Consent authority, field classification, lifecycle, corrections and a runtime gate.
verification_policy.verified_definition: Verification requires non-empty production evidence, tenant-scoped identity mapping, restricted-data controls and full-denominator independent reconciliation without exposing raw secrets or verification evidence.

lifecycle_policy_defaults.history_policy: Principal identity is stable; Profile, Consent, Membership and Verification claims are immutable versions; authentication and security observations append.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.delete_policy: Account closure revokes access and minimizes mutable projections while retaining legally required tokenized audit/financial references; it never hard-deletes Order, Payment or Ledger history.
lifecycle_policy_defaults.backfill_policy: Resolve tenant and qualified source identity before replay; tokenize restricted identifiers, separate consent/verification/profile/address/authentication and quarantine ambiguous status or raw-secret payloads.
